europe_now.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill at least 13 as Ukraine faces air defence shortages
europe_now.summary: Russian overnight strikes on Kyiv have killed at least 13 people, highlighting Ukraine's ongoing struggle with air defence shortages amid the intensifying conflict. The attacks underscore the severe humanitarian and security toll of the war on civilian populations.

europe_now.title: France investigates massive cyberattack on tax database
europe_now.summary: French authorities are investigating a major cyberattack that targeted the country's national tax database, raising concerns about data security and the vulnerability of critical government infrastructure. The incident has prompted widespread scrutiny of digital security measures across European public institutions.

top_stories.title: Amnesty demands EU stop outsourcing asylum over Meloni's Albania deal
top_stories.summary: Amnesty International has demanded that the European Union stop outsourcing asylum processing, accusing Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni of using authoritarian tactics to push through an asylum deal with Albania. The criticism highlights ongoing tensions over migration policies and human rights within the bloc.

europe_now.summary: Russian forces launched a major wave of attacks on Kyiv, killing at least 12 people and exposing critical gaps in Ukraine's air defence capabilities. The assault underscores the escalating intensity of the war and its toll on civilian infrastructure.

europe_now.title: France probes massive cyberattack on tax database amid broader European security concerns
europe_now.summary: French authorities are investigating a large-scale cyberattack targeting the national tax database, raising alarms about vulnerabilities in critical public infrastructure. The incident adds to growing concerns over state-sponsored digital threats across Europe.

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict deepens with military reshuffling and new battlefield developments
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has appointed a new defence minister amid ongoing political shifts, while recent strikes using Slovak-supplied MiG-29s highlight evolving military dynamics on the front lines. The war continues to reshape regional security alignments and domestic governance.

europe_now.summary: The European Union has announced plans to relax subsidy regulations for smaller media organizations to support independent journalism. This policy change aims to address funding challenges faced by regional and niche media outlets across the continent.

europe_now.title: EU backs top international court against onslaught from Trump and Rubio
europe_now.summary: The European Union has expressed strong support for the International Criminal Court following pressure from the United States and other critics. Member states have called for continued judicial independence despite external political pressures.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Appoints New Defence Minister Amid Political Changes
top_stories.summary: The Ukrainian parliament approved a new defence minister following a controversial reshuffle within the armed forces. This leadership transition occurs as the country continues its military operations against Russian forces.
